cohort: Consecutive patients undergoing abdominal surgery (including caesarean section) with an incision >5 cm recruited from centers in India, Mexico, Ghana, and Nigeria between April and October 2020.
finding: Surgical site infection (SSI) was associated with a 75.3% (412 international Euros) increase in postoperative healthcare costs after clean-contaminated surgery and a 66.6% (331 international Euros) increase after contaminated-dirty surgery.
